answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A island of per-task receipts records who did what, and the shale of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
